app.title: Rustorr
app.soon: This section arrives in a later stage.

torrents.title: Torrents
torrents.emptyHint: Add a magnet link, an info hash or a .torrent file.
torrents.removeConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the list? Its cached files will be deleted.

add.title: Add a torrent
add.link: Magnet link, info hash or link to a .torrent
add.name: Title
add.nameHint: Optional: the torrent's own name otherwise
add.saveHint: A saved torrent survives a server restart

torrent.noFiles: Files appear once the metadata arrives.
torrent.copyLink: Copy the link for a player

player.label: Player
player.failed: The browser could not play this file
player.cannotPlay: The browser does not support this format or codec.
player.noHls: The browser does not support HLS.
player.hlsNote: HLS: the server repackages the file with GStreamer, with audio and subtitle choice. Starting and seeking may take a few seconds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all BitTorrent settings to their defaults? Loaded torrents will be unloaded from memory.
settings.reconnectNote: Saving reconnects the torrent client, as in MatriX: torrents nobody is watching are unloaded from memory.
settings.readOnly: The server runs read-only: changes are not available.

notApplied.title: MatriX settings Rustorr does not apply yet
notApplied.hint: They are kept for MatriX clients but do not affect Rustorr: start-up options (port, DHT, proxy) control the engine's network.

cache.title: Cache and loading
cache.description: How much data to keep for seeking and how soon to free memory.
cache.sizeHint: Now: {{size}}. A soft limit: older pieces are evicted once it is exceeded.
cache.preloadHint: The share of the cache the server fills before streaming to the player.
cache.disconnectHint: A torrent nobody reads leaves memory; a saved one stays in the list.
cache.removeOnDropHint: Otherwise downloaded pieces stay on disk until evicted.
cache.readAheadHint: The share of the cache for data ahead of the reading position.

playback.title: Playback
playback.timecodeHint: The player resumes a file where it stopped. Positions are kept with the viewed marks.
playback.mergeM3uHint: The all-torrents playlist lists files in a row instead of nested playlists.
playback.fsActive: Show only loaded torrents in FUSE
playback.fsActiveHint: For the directory mounted with FUSE.

network.title: Network and trackers
network.description: Trackers the server adds to torrents.
network.retrackersHint: What to do with the list below when a torrent is added. “Remove” and “Replace” change magnet links and the tracker list, but Rustorr still announces to the torrent's own trackers: the engine cannot drop them.

discovery.title: DLNA and Bonjour
discovery.description: How TVs and apps find the server on the local network.
discovery.dlnaHint: TVs and media players see the torrents as a media library.
discovery.name: Server name
discovery.nameHint: The server's DLNA name; empty keeps the default.
discovery.bonjourHint: TorrServer apps find the server without typing its address.

search.title: Search
search.indexerCategoriesHint: Numbers separated by commas; empty means all.

tmdb.title: TMDB
tmdb.description: Posters and descriptions from The Movie Database.

waf.title: Access (WAF)
waf.description: Whom the server answers. Empty lists mean no restrictions.
waf.whitelistHint: IPs or CIDR ranges, one per line; when the list is not empty, other addresses are refused.
waf.blacklistHint: IPs or CIDR ranges, one per line.
waf.referersHint: Domains, one per line: requests from pages on these sites are refused.

warning.invalid_ip_range: List “{{list}}”, line {{line}}: not an address or a range, skipped.
warning.invalid_referer: List “{{list}}”, line {{line}}: not a domain, skipped.

gst.title: GStreamer
gst.description: Repackaging to HLS for playback in the browser.
gst.notBuiltIn: The server was built without the GStreamer module: HLS is not available and files play directly.
gst.sourceHint: Where the pipeline reads the torrent's file from.
gst.segmentDiffHint: How many segments ahead the pipeline runs on instead of restarting.
gst.subtitlesHint: Text tracks are served as WebVTT.
gst.hdrHint: Tone mapping for screens without HDR.
gst.ultrafastHint: Faster and larger with software encoding.
gst.resetConfirm: Reset the GStreamer settings to their defaults?

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Where the server keeps its settings and viewed marks.

about.title: About
about.text: Rustorr is a torrent streaming server compatible with TorrServer clients.
about.stopConfirm: Stop the server? Playback stops, and it can only be started again on the machine it runs on.
about.stopped: The server is stopping. This page will stop answering.
